name: use-built-in-microphone
title: Use Built In Microphone
description:
When you're connected to AirPods (or similar), macOS often picks the headphone mic by default — and the audio quality can be awful. 
 This command instantly switches your input to the built‑in Mac microphone. It’s not elegant, but it’s quick and clean enough for temporary use. ( and sometimes just not making use of Macbooks' great microphone is kinda pity. )
author: Az0s

commands.name: use-built-in-microphone
commands.title: Switch to Built-in Microphone
commands.description: Switch audio input to the Mac’s built‑in microphone.
